panel_a_left.n_definition: All Hchi-valid ubiquitin chain-A residues, including three valid zero-entropy prolines. Not 66 independent proteins.
panel_a_left.model: Frozen full-model test output, fold 0. No refit or new seed.
panel_a_left.reference: Mean original joint Hchi over five consecutive 1000-frame windows of the same existing MD trajectory. These are not independent MD repeats.
panel_a_left.MAE_definition: Mean absolute model-minus-reference joint-Hchi difference across all included residues, nats.
panel_a_left.rho_definition: Spearman rank correlation across all included residues.
panel_a_left.corrected_rho_definition: Previously frozen Spearman correlation after subtracting each training-set amino-acid-type mean from both model and reference.
panel_a_left.test_or_multiple_correction: No new significance test; no multiple-comparison correction.

panel_a_right.n_definition: All six ubiquitin glutamines Q2, Q31, Q40, Q41, Q49, Q62; no omission.
panel_a_right.display: MD reference hollow circles and full-model filled squares, joined within each residue.
panel_a_right.signed_error_storage: Preserved in all6_sequence_order.csv signed_error_nats and points.csv error; removed uniformly from plot text.

panels_b_d.n: Two residues x three angles x 72 five-degree bins = 432 original curve rows.
panels_b_d.frame_scope: Existing 0–100 ns, 200 ps interval, 501 frames, exactly as v33.
panels_b_d.selection: Frozen-model minimum Q41 and maximum Q2 among all six GLN, not selected by observed error.
panels_b_d.Fstar_definition: -ln(bin_probability / maximum_bin_probability); zero-count bins remain undefined and unconnected.
panels_b_d.low_Fstar_width: Sum of 5-degree bins with finite Fstar <= 1; grid origin 0 degrees.
panels_b_d.spread_or_CI: None. No new MD run or statistical test.

source_traceability.source/all66_residue_summary.csv: All 66 joint-Hchi paired values and residue identifiers.
source_traceability.source/fig7_all_residues_Gln_and_MD_free: Previously frozen overall and all-six metrics.

export.crop: Original tight crop retained for v33 visual consistency; dimensions reported explicitly.
